interpretation.summary: The discussion revolves around the classification of borderline items and the inconsistency in labeling by different reviewers. Carla notes that some L0s classify borderline items more strictly. Jun points out that two reviewers assigned different labels to the same contextual passage. Leo advises that since the two submissions share the same relevant context, the same safety threshold should be applied, and any genuine differences should be recorded explicitly.
interpretation.central_question: How should reviewers handle the classification of borderline items when different labels are assigned to the same contextual passage?
interpretation.resolution_rationale: Leo's response provides clear guidance on applying the same safety threshold for submissions with the same relevant context and recording any genuine differences, thus fully addressing the classification issue raised in the thread.
